verdict.rationale: Paxos documents its own rule-based orchestrations that fire automatically when a bank transfer arrives and perform fiat-to-stablecoin conversion and transfer. It also documents automatic conversion of received stablecoin payments to fiat, but both are fixed, domain-specific flows rather than a general rule engine. Webhooks only notify external endpoints and are not product-side event-to-action rules, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: a general-purpose rule/trigger definition across arbitrary event types, documentation of rule configuration depth (conditions, multiple actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
